title: 第25章 全部正确第26章 基础冥想法巫师议会第777版
slug: 巫师让你学知识你杀穿万界
lines: 老者把那叠试卷按在石板上，光芒扫过每一页，每一行，每一个字母。
几息后，石板表面浮现出一行行细密的文字：
【试卷编号：wls-097231】
【考生姓名：伊森·里奥】
【考试科目：巫师语全章认证】
【答题数量：完整】
【正确率检测中......】
【检测完成。】
【检测结果：全部正确。】
【异常情况：无。】
【判定：通过。】
中年女人的眼睛微微睁大，那淡漠的神情彻底消失，取而代之的是难以掩饰的震惊。
老者倒是面色不变，只是点了点头。
他收回手，转过身看向伊森。
“全对。”他的声音依旧沙哑低沉，“巫师语认证考试，满分。”
伊森微微挑眉，脸上依旧平静。
老者盯着他看了几息，忽然扯了扯嘴角，露出一丝极淡的笑意。
“新生，三十七天，学完巫师语全部课程，认证考试满分。你知不知道，这成绩意味着什么？”
伊森摇头：“不知道。”
“意味着你有资格获得基础冥想法。”老者顿了顿，“也意味着，你可以拿到这个。”
他从怀里摸出一枚拇指大小的晶石，扔给伊森。
伊森抬手接住。
晶石入手微凉，表面流转着淡淡的金色纹路，隐约能看见内部有细小的光芒在缓慢旋转。
“五十魔石。”老者开口，“认证考试满分的奖励。拿着这个去后勤，就能换到。”
伊森的瞳孔微微收缩。
五十魔石？
他原本以为能有个十块八块就不错了。
这奖励，比他预想的多得多。
“怎么，嫌少？”老者挑了挑眉。
“不。”伊森把晶石收进怀里，“多谢。”
老者摆了摆手：“行了，别谢了。这奖励是学院定的规矩，不是我的恩惠。你能拿到，是你自己的本事。”
他顿了顿，目光在伊森身上又转了一圈。
“新生，三十七天学完巫师语，认证考试满分。这成绩，在血骨塔历史上也算不错了。好好修炼，别浪费了这份天赋。”
说完，他转身朝那扇门走去。
后勤区在学院的最西侧，是一大片低矮却占地极广的建筑群。
伊森踏进后勤区大门时，入目是一片开阔得惊人的空间。
这片低矮的建筑群从外面看着不起眼，内部却别有洞天。
穹顶高达数十米，由某种半透明的材质构筑，自然光线穿透后变得柔和均匀，将整个大厅照得通亮。
大厅被分割成数十个功能区，每个区域都用低矮的石墙隔开，墙上挂着醒目的指示牌。
“物资兑换”、“任务发布”、“材料收购”......
各个窗口前都排着长队。
伊森目光扫过那些指示牌，径直走向“物资兑换”区域。
那是一个长约二十米的石质柜台，柜台后站着五个穿着深灰色制服的工作人员。
content_en:
The old man pressed the stack of test papers on the stone slab, and the light swept across every page, every line, and every letter.
After a few breaths, lines of fine text appeared on the surface of the stone slab:
[Exam paper number: wls-097231]
[Candidate Name: Ethan Leo]
[Examination subject: Wizarding language full chapter certification]
[Number of answers: Complete]
[Accuracy rate testing...]
[Detection completed. 】
[Test results: All correct. 】
[Exception: None. 】
[Judgment: Passed. 】
The middle-aged woman's eyes widened slightly, and her indifferent expression completely disappeared, replaced by unconcealable shock.
The old man's expression remained unchanged and he just nodded.
He retracted his hand and turned to look at Ethan.
"Absolutely correct." His voice was still hoarse and low, "Wizard Language Certification Examination, perfect score."
Ethan raised his eyebrows slightly, his face still calm.
The old man stared at him for a few seconds, then suddenly twitched the corner of his mouth, revealing a faint smile.
"Freshmen, thirty-seven days, complete all wizarding language courses, and get perfect scores on the certification exam. Do you know what this score means?"
Ethan shook his head: "I don't know."
"It means you are qualified to obtain the basic meditation method." The old man paused, "It also means you can get this."
He took out a thumb-sized crystal from his arms and threw it to Ethan.
Ethan raised his hand to catch it.
The crystal is slightly cool to the touch, with faint golden lines flowing on the surface, and a small light slowly rotating inside can be vaguely seen.
"Fifty magic stones." The old man said, "The reward for perfect scores in the certification exam. Take this to the logistics and you can exchange it for it."
Ethan's pupils shrank slightly.
Fifty magic stones?
He originally thought it would be good to have ten or eight yuan.
This reward was much more than he expected.
"What? Too young?" The old man raised his eyebrows.
"No." Ethan took the crystal into his arms, "Thank you."
The old man waved his hand: "Okay, don't thank me. This reward is a rule set by the academy, not a favor from me. You can get it because of your own ability."
He paused and looked around Ethan again.
"Freshmen, after learning Wizarding Language in thirty-seven days, they got full marks on the certification exam. This result is pretty good in the history of the Blood Bone Tower. Practice hard and don't waste this talent."
After saying that, he turned and walked towards the door.
The logistics area is on the westernmost side of the college. It is a large group of low-rise buildings that occupy an extremely large area.
When Ethan stepped into the door of the logistics area, he saw an amazingly open space.
This low-rise building complex looks unremarkable from the outside, but it is unique inside.
The dome is tens of meters high and is made of some kind of translucent material. After the natural light penetrates, it becomes soft and even, illuminating the entire hall.
The hall is divided into dozens of functional areas, each separated by low stone walls with eye-catching signage.
"Material exchange", "task release", "material acquisition"...
There were long queues at every window.
Ethan glanced at the signs and went straight to the "Material Exchange" area.
It was a stone counter about twenty meters long, with five staff members in dark gray uniforms standing behind the counter.
